value.title: Vel' d'Hiv roundup
value.snippet: The Vel' d'Hiv' roundup ( [vel ˈdiv] vell-DEEV; from French: la rafle du Vel' d'Hiv', an abbreviation of la rafle du Vélodrome d'Hiver) was a mass arrest

value.title: Vélodrome d'Hiver
value.snippet: extermination camp at Auschwitz. The incident became known as the "Vel' d'Hiv roundup" (rafle du Vel' d'Hiv'). The original track was housed in the Salles des Machines

value.title: The Round Up (2010 film)
value.snippet: true story of a young Jewish boy, the film depicts the Vel' d'Hiv Roundup (Rafle du Vel' d'Hiv), the mass arrest of Jews by French police who were accomplices
